Industry Ground Reality/Deep-Dive Supply Chain Research · India & Global Logistics

The last mile is where
margin, time & fleet capacity leak out.

Distribution networks operate on paper habits and gut feel. Vehicles roll out with empty volume, stops are driven out of sync, and morning dock crews lose hours manually sequencing dispatches. Across Indian supply chains, three structural bottlenecks paralyze fleet productivity:

📦 The LIFO Box-Trap CAB-TO-DOOR CRISIS
Drivers unload earlier drops onto muddy roads to reach deeper cartons.
When loading order does not match reverse drop sequence, cartons for Stop 1 are buried behind Stop 8. Drivers waste 9–15 minutes per stop digging, leading to crushed packaging, broken seals, and delayed runs.
Impact: 2–4 crew hours lost per truck-day and elevated damage claims.
🗺️ Route-Volume Disconnect PHYSICS BLIND SPOT
2D GPS map routing ignores 3D cubic volume and axle weight limits.
Conventional telematics and route planners solve simple point-to-point mileage. They fail to couple vehicle axle weight balance (CMVR Rule 93), crate stackability limits, and customer unload time windows, causing 40% empty running.
Impact: ~40% empty running and premature vehicle suspension fatigue.
⏱️ 3-Hour Morning Bottleneck WHITEBOARD DEADLOCK
Dispatch managers spend 3 hours every morning manually sorting orders.
Hundreds of retail dealer orders arrive overnight via PDF invoices, ERP spreadsheets, and WhatsApp messages. Whiteboard dispatching creates dispatch gridlock, late departures, and missed commercial delivery SLAs.
Impact: 3–4 hours dock idle time before wheels turn, inflating fixed fleet overhead.

The Solution · FleetFlow/Gemini Enterprise · Google ADK · Vertex AI Agent Engine

Load it in reverse.
Drive it in order. Deliver it all.

FleetFlow is an autonomous dispatch engine for primary and secondary distribution. Each morning it decides which trucks roll out and which corridor each driver takes. It then works out the drop order and where every carton sits, so drop 1 is at the door and the last drop sits behind the cab. Crews stop digging for cartons, and the fleet runs fewer kilometres.

How FleetFlow Works/From Raw Orders to Ready-to-Roll Trucks in 17 Seconds

From order backlog to loaded, routed trucks in 17 seconds.

1

Multimodal Intake & Intent Scoping

Ingests ERP sheets, BigQuery orders, and dock photos via Gemini 3.7. Accommodates driver direction claims ("Ravi takes West") without breaking schedule constraints.

2

Polar Corridors & OR-Tools Solver

Partitions stops into 8 directional corridors and branches heavy routes. Google OR-Tools solves multi-vehicle CVRPTW using live traffic road network geodesics.

3

3D LIFO Packing & Edge Dispatch

Discrete height-map places Stop 1 cartons at the rear roll-up door and verifies CMVR Rule 93 axle balance. Emits 1-tap Google Maps and WhatsApp run sheets.

The door rule, visualised
T17-1 · 15 drops · S corridor · number = drop sequence

Loading follows the reverse of the route. At every stop, that stop's cartons are the first ones the crew reaches, with no re-handling. The same plan is shown in the agent as an animated 3D loading sequence (MP4 plus an interactive canvas).

Algorithmic Decision Tree & Reasoning Flow/Discrete Branching, Radial Scanning & Heuristic Loops

Autonomous decision tree.
From dock scan to certified route in 17 seconds.

Every dispatch turn executes through deterministic gates: multimodal intake, security quarantine, driver intent scoping, polar radial scanning, capacity divergence, and 3D height-map safety validation.

🛡️ 1. Intake & Security Gate
Dock QR camera frames, ERP Excel spreadsheets, and BigQuery orders sanitized via Google Cloud Model Armor and Cloud DLP before LLM processing.
🧭 2. Polar Corridors & Branching
Polar ray θ scan groups stops into 8 compass corridors. Volume and weight overflow triggers angular divergence, splitting routes into non-overlapping branches.
🧮 3. OR-Tools CVRPTW & 3D LIFO Physics
OR-Tools VRPTW routes highway itineraries, while discrete 3D height-map raster packing enforces cab-to-door LIFO drop safety and CMVR Rule 93 axle balance.
Enterprise Architecture & Dual Deployment/One Shared Backend · Two Deployment Surfaces · Zero Hardcoded Credentials

Unified agent core.
Native to Gemini Enterprise, extensible to Cloud Run.

FleetFlow is built on Google Cloud's modern AI stack: Google ADK for tool orchestration, Vertex AI Agent Engine for enterprise reasoning, BigQuery for telemetry, and Cloud Run for low-latency web UI.

Option A · Gemini Enterprise Deploy

./scripts/deploy.sh --target gemini-enterprise --project YOUR_PROJECT — provisions IAM, updates Vertex AI Agent Engine in-place, and registers in Gemini Enterprise.

Option B · Cloud Run Control Tower UI

./scripts/deploy.sh --target ui --project YOUR_PROJECT — builds and deploys the standalone Web Control Tower & 3D Load Studio container to Google Cloud Run.

Option C · Full Stack + BigQuery Seed

./scripts/deploy.sh --target all --publish-data --project YOUR_PROJECT — seeds BigQuery & Cloud Storage and deploys both surfaces simultaneously.

Enterprise Security & Zero-Trust Governance/Model Armor · Cloud DLP · Deterministic Enclave · VPC-SC

Zero-trust supply chain.
Enterprise guardrails at every layer.

Logistics networks handle sensitive customer locations, pricing contracts, and driver telemetry. FleetFlow enforces multi-layered defense to prevent prompt injection, data exfiltration, and model hallucinations.

🛡️ Model Armor PROMPT INJECTION SHIELD
Real-time LLM input/output sanitization before Gemini.
Quarantines prompt injection attacks, malicious instruction overrides, and system prompt leakage attempts. Latency overhead <15ms; 100% of adversarial payloads intercepted.
Guardrail: Google Cloud Model Armor · Pre-LLM filter
🔒 Cloud DLP PII & TAX IDENTIFIER MASK
Automated masking of dealer phone numbers and GSTIN.
Scans order manifests and ERP sheets to tokenize customer telephone numbers, GSTIN IDs, and commercial invoice amounts. Reversible HMAC tokens ensure raw PII never leaves VPC.
Inspection: GSTIN, Phone, PAN, Banking · Zero PII Leakage
⚡ Deterministic Enclave & Ledger MATH AIR-GAP & HMAC AUDIT
Zero-hallucination execution coupled with cryptographic audit.
Gemini never guesses coordinates or cubic loads. Dual-guard ADK callbacks validate all outputs against OR-Tools and physics engines. Every run logs a SHA-256 HMAC hash chain to BigQuery.
Enclave: Hard physics error on overflow · Immutable BigQuery audit

Empowering drivers on the highway.

Logistics technology fails when contract drivers refuse to install heavy proprietary apps. FleetFlow bridges the dispatch manager cockpit directly to highway crews using universal, lightweight edge interfaces:

🗺️ 1-Tap Google Maps LIVE NAVIGATION
Pre-sequenced highway navigation directly in Google Maps.
Emits turn-by-turn multi-waypoint navigation links (dir_action=navigate) with live traffic re-routing, bridge clearance awareness, and 1-tap direct dealer call dials.
Driver Action: 1 tap opens native Google Maps app with all stops pre-sequenced
📱 Mobile Driver Portal ZERO-LOGIN PWA
Dedicated live run sheet generated per truck on the fly.
Lightweight zero-login web app with three intuitive tabs: Stop List 1➔N with arrival ETAs, interactive Leaflet live route map, and 3D truck cargo bay view with cab-to-door depth markers.

Instant WhatsApp notification paired with camera proof of delivery.
Single tap transmits departure time, corridor, dealer drop count, and portal URL to driver WhatsApp. Upon drop, mobile camera captures photo POD with GPS timestamp written to BigQuery.

The Optimization Engine/Coupled NP-Hard Solvers · OR-Tools VRPTW · 3D Height-Map LIFO · CMVR Rule 93

Mathematical precision.
Zero guesswork on road or dock.

FleetFlow pairs Google OR-Tools Vehicle Routing (VRPTW) and polar corridor clustering with a discrete 3D height-map bin packing engine and vehicle axle load balance physics.

🧭 Polar Corridors & Branching GEOGRAPHIC CLUSTERING
8-Ray radial compass projection with highway branching.
Maps dealer coordinates into polar vectors relative to the DC. Stops are partitioned into 8 compass corridors. Volume and weight overflow triggers angular divergence, splitting routes into non-overlapping branches (e.g. West-1, West-2) to avoid criss-crossing.
Solves: Corridor clustering · Route criss-crossing · Driver direction locks
🛣️ Google OR-Tools CVRPTW MIP ROUTING SOLVER
Constrained vehicle routing with live Google Maps geodesics.
Solves multi-constraint MIP optimization: dual vehicle capacity (Weight & Volume), time windows with unloading slack, driver corridor locks, and heterogeneous fleet costs. Turn-by-turn distance and travel time matrices powered by Google Routes API v2.
Constraints: Capacity (Weight & Volume) · Time Windows · Heterogeneous Fleet
📦 3D LIFO & Axle Physics CAB-TO-DOOR PACKING
Discrete 1 cm raster height-map with statutory axle reactions.
Inverts drop sequence so Stop 1 sits at the rear roll-up door. Discretizes cargo bed into elevation matrix Z(x, y), verifies ≥80% bottom support, and places heavy pails on floor. Dynamically computes 3D Center of Gravity ensuring steer axle carries 32%–45% and drive axle 55%–68% per CMVR Rule 93.
Statutory: Indian Central Motor Vehicles Rules 1989 Rule 93 axle compliance
